call.bridges.en: Listen, let me ask you something else.
Now let's change the subject a little.

call.bridges.tx: Endi menga boshqa bir narsani aytib ber.

call.leadIns.en: Tell me a bit about it.

chat.goodbyes.en: Nice to hear from you! Shall we write tomorrow?
OK, I have to go now. See you soon!
Thanks for telling me. Talk later!
chat.goodbyes.tx: Aytib berganing uchun rahmat. Keyinroq gaplashamiz!

chat.opener.day.en: Hey! How did your day go?

chat.thread.day.en: And what are you doing tomorrow?

chat.opener.plan.en: Shall we meet this week? When are you free?
chat.opener.plan.tx: Shu hafta ko'rishamizmi? Qachon bo'sh bo'lasan?

chat.opener.favour.en: Can I ask you a favor?

chat.thread.favour.en: Are you sure? Tell me everything.

chat.opener.place.en: Where are you? Tell me what it's like there.
chat.opener.place.tx: Qayerdasan? U yer qanaqa, aytib ber.

chat.thread.place.en: What can you see from the window?
Who did you go there with?

chat.opener.food.en: I'm hungry. What shall we eat tonight?

chat.thread.food.en: Are you cooking or shall we order?

chat.opener.news.en: Guess what happened to me today!

chat.thread.news.en: And what will you do now?

chat.opener.problem.en: I have a problem… what would you do?
chat.opener.problem.tx: Bir muammom bor… sen bo'lsang nima qilarding?

chat.thread.problem.en: Do you want me to help?
Whose fault is it, in your opinion?

chat.opener.memory.en: Do you remember that time? I can't remember how it ended.
chat.opener.memory.tx: O'sha safar esingdami? Qanday tugaganini eslay olmayapman.
